entries.reason: Add explicit v1 generation and read-only verification commands so pinned consumers can consume selected versioned packages without copying compiler internals or mutating canonical source.
Wire the reusable v1 consumer source adapter into the compiler and reference renderer, keeping generation transactional and verification read-only at the immutable consumer boundary.
Export the v1 consumer adapter and register the bounded generation and verification commands while preserving the original Empathy extraction digest and v0 CLI behavior.
